alex: FYI: releasebot attempted to cut v2.4.1 for a docs-only PR. Question: should docs-only deserve a numeric patch bump or stay as buildmeta? @nina
nina: my vote is buildmeta (v2.4.0+docs.1). Patch bumps are visible to customers who pin X.Y.Z and we shouldn't churn that for docs.
deploy-bot: releasebot: queued v2.4.0+docs.1 -> stable (no patch bump)
sam: operational note: our release-notes generator currently ignores buildmeta tags. if we go buildmeta-first, we need changelog changes or folks will miss doc fixes.
ira: another angle: internal platform teams sometimes depend on patch increments for telemetry. we should announce the new semantics and add a cross-ref in release notes.
alex: suggestion: docs-only -> buildmeta. releasebot should emit a short annotated changelog entry and also post a slack digest to #general-releases.
nina: agree. also add a lightweight test that releasebot rejects buildmeta-only when a PR touches API or code. prevents accidental mislabeling.
sam: canary report: quick smoke OK. No rollout issues. Will add playbook blurb: how rollbacks are named (vX.Y.Z-rollback-<shortsha>).
ira: low friction: update our internal pinning docs to explain + recommend customers use major.minor pins, not patch, for stable tracking.
alex: ok next steps: Nina open small PR to change release-notes pipeline, Sam update playbook, I'll tweak releasebot to publish slack digest when buildmeta releases happen.
sam: noted. I'll include the rollback naming convention in the playbook PR.
nina: will do the changelog patch today.
alex: thanks all. closing thread.
